# KafkaRequestHandlerSaturated

<!-- GENERATED by monitoring/dashgen from internal/rules (make alerts). Do not edit. -->

| Severity | Component | Dashboard | for (production / demo) |
|---|---|---|---|
| warning | kafka | [kafka-broker](http://grafana.localhost:8080/d/kafka-broker/) | 10m / 1m |

**Summary:** Request handler threads of broker <kafka_broker> are more than 80 % busy

Requests queue up for an I/O thread and latency grows. Add brokers, raise num.io.threads (if CPU is available) or reduce the request rate (bigger batches, fewer Metadata requests).

## Impact

Requests wait in the request queue for an I/O thread; latency grows for every client of the broker.

## Diagnosis

1. Kafka · Broker Deep Dive → Request rate by type: did a client start flooding (Metadata, tiny Produce batches)?
2. Thread pools & queues: request queue size and handler idle per broker.

## Mitigation

- Fix the noisy client (batching: linger.ms/batch.size; metadata refresh), add quotas.
- Raise num.io.threads if CPU is available, or add brokers.

## Expression

```promql
max by (kafka_cluster, kafka_broker) (kafka:request_handler_idle:ratio_rate5m) < 0.2
```
